title: Pure awareness is a Bayesian representation of tonic alertness

statements.text: The phenomenological prototype of "pure awareness", to which reports of pure consciousness refer, is the content of a predictive model, a Bayesian representation of tonic alertness: the sustained, internally initiated wakefulness that does not depend on external cues. More abstractly it may be a model of an unpartitioned epistemic space.
